label: beech + 4 maple · spacing 5 m · target height 20 m · twig density 20 % · foliation 100 %
subtitle: 3 models · 1.0 of 2.5 M points
description: A synthetic stand of 5 trees (beech + 4 maple) with a target height of 20 m, generated with The Grove and virtually laser-scanned with HELIOS++ matched to the ECOSENSE acquisition. A test stand of the full stand set (73 stands, including the fully foliated ones): the models shown were not trained on it.

frame.description: Local frame of the synthetic stand in meters, without a geographic reference: x and y horizontal with the origin at the stand center, z = height above the flat virtual ground (z = 0). Returns below 1 m are removed (ground removal), and the LAI labels exclude the leaf area below 1 m.

layers.label: LAI label
layers.notes: Exact partial LAI of the leaf meshes: one-sided leaf area per 2 m × 2 m prediction column and 2 m height bin, divided by 4 m²; leaf area below 1 m excluded, as in the training labels.

layers.label: Feature-MLP, trained on the full stand set
layers.short: Feature-MLP, trained on the full stand set
layers.notes: Trained on the training partition of the full stand set (73 stands, including the fully foliated ones) with the height shift of the tallest stands (labels up to 44–46 m). LAI cap: no LAI above the highest height bin of the prediction column with at least three returns. The total LAI of a prediction column is the sum of its profile.

layers.label: Random Forest, trained on the full stand set
layers.short: Random Forest, trained on the full stand set
layers.notes: Trained on the training partition of the full stand set (73 stands, including the fully foliated ones) with the height shift of the tallest stands (labels up to 44–46 m). LAI cap: no LAI above the highest height bin of the prediction column with at least three returns. The Random Forest consists of two models, one for the total LAI and one for the profile; the profile is rescaled to the total LAI of each prediction column (all zeros where it sums to 0).
